blocks.h3: 3.2 Short-term data transmission to AI services (Mistral AI)

blocks.note: NOTE – Data processing: For AI-powered analysis, summarization, simplification and translation of documents, the relevant text content is briefly transmitted to the AI service Mistral AI (Mistral AI S.A.S., 15 rue des Halles, 75001 Paris, France).

blocks.p: (1) Type of data transmitted: Only the text content extracted from documents and document images for OCR processing are sent to Mistral AI — no account data of the user.

(2) Purpose of transmission: The transmission serves exclusively for processing by AI language models to provide the user with the following functions: document extraction (OCR), analysis and categorization, text simplification (e.g. medical reports), translation into other languages, detection of deadlines and action-relevant content, generation of reply letters, official explanations and legal assessments.

(3) Duration of processing: The data is processed by Mistral AI exclusively for the duration of the respective API request (typically a few seconds). According to their terms of use, Mistral AI does not store user data permanently and does not use it to train its own models.

(4) Legal basis: The transmission takes place on the basis of Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (performance of a contract). Since Mistral AI is based in France (EU), there is no third-country transfer — data processing remains entirely within the EEA and is subject to the GDPR.
(5) Security measures: Communication with Mistral AI takes place exclusively via encrypted HTTPS/TLS connections. API keys are stored server-side and never transmitted to the client.
(6) The user may opt out of the AI functions at any time by not using the relevant features. In that case, no data is transmitted to Mistral AI.
